items.title: 21.11 Duniya ka mausam aur Sooraj se tawanai ki muntaqili (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of global climate and energy transfer from the Sun (PDF 179-181).

blocks.text: Sooraj se milne wali tawanai duniya ke mausam ki tabdeeliyon mein ahem kirdar ada karti hai. Yeh hissa batata hai ke Sooraj ki tawanai zameen par kaise taqseem hoti hai, aur khat-e-istiwa aur qutbon ke darmiyan na-barabar hararat fiza mein tabdeeliyan kaise lati hai.

blocks.title: Zameen ka energy budget
blocks.text: Zameen ka energy budget zameen ki jazb ki hui Sooraj ki tawanai aur us ki khala mein wapas kharij ki hui tawanai ke darmiyan tawazun hai.

Yeh napta hai ke Sooraj ki kitni tawanai zameen tak pohanchti aur kitni inikas aur ikhraj se khala mein zaya hoti hai. Jab zameen thandi hoti hai to satah par zyada barf aur baraf-baari hoti hai; barf chamakdar hai aur bohat si dhoop wapas khala mein mun'akis karti hai, jis se zameen aur thandi hoti hai. Jab zameen garam hoti hai to barf pighal kar gehri zameen aur samandar khul jate hain, jo zyada dhoop jazb aur kam mun'akis karte hain, aur zameen mazeed garam hoti hai. Sooraj se aane wali tawanai infrared (hararat) shuaon ki shakal mein jane wali tawanai se mutawazin hoti hai (Fig 21.12). Jab tak yeh tawazun qaim rahe, zameen ka darja hararat mustaqil rehta hai. Lekin greenhouse gases infrared shuaon ko qaid kar ke khala mein jane se rokti hain; nateejatan zameen garam ho rahi hai, jise global warming kehte hain.

blocks.alt: EARTH'S ENERGY BUDGET. Dhoop seedhi zameen ki satah tak aati hai, aur aik shaakh badal tak (Absorption of Solar Radiation by Atmosphere). Satah se: Convection and Conduction, Evaporation aur Latent Heat, khala aur fiza ki taraf infrared. Fiza se: khala aur zameen ki taraf infrared. Labels: Energy Gain by Atmosphere, Energy Loss from Atmosphere, Energy Loss aur Energy Gain at Earth's Surface, khali dabbon ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.12: zameen ke energy budget ka khaaka (kitab ki Figure 21.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen hissa batata hai ke satah tawanai kaise khoti hai (convection, evaporation se latent heat, infrared), aur daen hissa ke satah tawanai kaise pati hai (dhoop aur fiza se wapas aane wali infrared). Khali dabbe kitab ne is liye chhore hain ke un mein tawanai ki miqdar likhi ja sake. Jab zameen ki jazb ki hui dhoop (taqreeban 70 feesad) khala mein jane wali infrared ke barabar ho to darja hararat qaim rehta hai; greenhouse gases zyada infrared wapas bhejein to zameen garam hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Zameen tak pohanchne wali Sooraj ki tawanai ka sirf taqreeban 70 feesad zameen jazb karti hai; baqi badal, barf aur registani satahein khala mein wapas mun'akis karti hain. Is budget mein 1 feesad ka adam-tawazun duniya ke darja hararat mein bari tabdeeliyan la sakta hai.
2. Qutbon aur khat-e-istiwa ke darmiyan tawanai ka adam-tawazun

Zameen ka mausami nizam us ki satah par Sooraj ki tawanai ki na-barabar taqseem se banta hai (Fig 21.13). Khat-e-istiwa ko seedhi, tez dhoop milti hai, is liye wahan garam hawa uth kar kam dabao ke ilaqe banati hai, jab ke qutbon ko tirchi, kamzor dhoop milti hai, jis se thandi neeche baithti hawa aur zyada dabao ke ilaqe bante hain. Tawanai ka yeh adam-tawazun duniya ki fazai gardish chalata aur khat-e-istiwa ke qareeb trade winds, darmiyani arz-e-balad (mid-latitudes) mein westerlies aur qutbon ke qareeb polar easterlies jaise hawa ke naqshe banata hai. Yeh hawayein samandari dhaaron ke saath mil kar duniya bhar mein hararat dobara taqseem karti hain. Insanon ki greenhouse gases ka ikhraj is qudrati tawazun ko bigar kar global warming barha aur mausami naqshe badal raha hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Sooraj se mutawazi Sun's rays aik jhuki hui zameen par aati hain jis ke gird patli fiza hai. Beech wali shua par 'Sunlight Strikes Most Directly', oopar neeche wali par 'Low Angle of Incoming Sunlight'. Arz-e-balad ki lakeerein: Arctic Circle, 60 darje N, 30 darje N, Tropic of Cancer, Equator, Tropic of Capricorn, 30 darje S, 60 darje S, Antarctic Circle; North Pole aur South Pole.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.13: qutbon aur khat-e-istiwa ke darmiyan tawanai ka adam-tawazun (kitab ki Figure 21.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Khat-e-istiwa ke qareeb dhoop seedhi parti hai, is liye utni hi shua chhote raqbe par girti hai aur zyada garmi deti hai. Qutbon ke qareeb shua tirchi (low angle) aati hai aur bare raqbe par phail jati hai. Kaali lakeerein 30 aur 60 darje arz-e-balad hain; safed dashed lakeerein Tropic of Cancer/Capricorn (23.5 darje) aur Arctic/Antarctic Circle (66.5 darje) hain. Kitab har label mein dono naam saath likhti hai.

blocks.prompt: Khat-e-istiwa ko qutbon se fi square metre zyada Sooraj ki tawanai kyun milti hai?
blocks.explanation: Dhoop khat-e-istiwa par taqreeban seedhi parti hai, is liye shua chhote raqbe par mutamarkiz hoti hai; qutbon par kam zawiye par parti hai, is liye wahi shua kaheen bare raqbe par phailti hai (aur zyada fiza se bhi guzarti hai).

items: Energy budget: jazb dhoop (taqreeban 70%) = khala mein kharij infrared.
Barf dhoop mun'akis karti; pighalti barf se mazeed garmi; greenhouse gases infrared qaid karti.
Khat-e-istiwa qutbon se zyada garam: hawayein chalti (trade winds, westerlies, polar easterlies).
